title: Display switcher offers List, Tech View and Board View and marks the active one
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • [Tech-A]: one eligible technician at this location. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher" (used by this case only) with two Approved work orders: [WO-1] led by [Tech-A] and [WO-2] with no lead.
  • Work Orders starts in List (the expected results say List is highlighted at the start).
  • Names and numbers are examples; what must hold: there are work orders to show in every display and the page starts in List.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Create everything below in this location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A].
    • [WO-2] (e.g. S1-352): no lead (Lead Technician left empty).
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > click Search and type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher": exactly [WO-1] (lead [Tech-A]) and [WO-2] (no lead) show. If a lead is wrong, fix it on the work order page. Then clear the search; if the page is not in List, click List (tooltip "List") in the display switcher.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top navigation.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. Look at the display switcher at the right of the toolbar and hover each of its buttons.
  4. Write down the label or tooltip of each button and which one is highlighted.
  5. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View").
  6. Look at which switcher button is highlighted now.
  7. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View").
  8. Look at which switcher button is highlighted now.
  9. In the display switcher, click List (tooltip "List").
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The switcher offers exactly three display options: List, Tech View and Board View.
  • Only the option you are viewing is highlighted: List at the start, Tech View after step 5, Board View after step 7, List again after step 9.
  • Write down the words you see on each button or tooltip. The design's tooltips read "Table", "By Lead Tech" and "Board". A different label alone is not a fail (the wording is an open product question), but a missing option or no highlight is.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S1-R1, S1-R9, read 8 Oct 2026. Design: Claude Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), toolbar view switch (aria-label "View"); on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R1: “The Work Orders toolbar offers List, Tech View, and Board View display options.”
  • S1-R9: “The switcher visually indicates the active display option.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
